children: Abpro Holdings reports that Miles Suk voluntarily resigned as Chairman of the Board, effective August 25, 2026, and will remain a director.
Resigned as Chairman; Continues as Director
Voluntary resignation; not due to any disagreement with the Company
Board will appoint successor Chair at next regularly scheduled meeting
Previously resigned as Chief Executive Officer; had a consulting agreement terminated in connection with that resignation
Will remain a member of the Board; other committee role changes not disclosed
Entitled to $300,000 annual consulting fee for 60 days post-termination; Company will pay $50,000 during the 60-day period beginning August 19, 2026; otherwise only standard directors' fees
